question: Will Ethereum close above $1,900 on August 9?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the CoinGecko closing price of Ethereum (ETH) for August 9, 2026, as shown in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Ethereum Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/ethereum/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-09, is strictly greater than $1,900.00. A close of exactly $1,900.00 or below resolves NO.
